title: te_abundance_ingest_v1 — manifest contract for the long-format TE-abundance TSV
description: Validates POST /api/actions when type='te_abundance_ingest'. Resolves a `TE_data_figure1_*.tsv` (long format: one row per species × Repeat_Class × Repeat_Family) from the workspace and emits a te_abundance_v0 envelope (Chapter 5 Fig 5.1 source).

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the long-format TE abundance TSV.

subject.description: Optional tag for the cohort the table describes (e.g. 'catfish_17_genomes').
